brief: Two loose ends of the camera (#80). c119: FACES hit-boxes and the LIT_PANES/halo overlays are registered in screen space at cache time, so during the 0.9 s ease the window glows drift off their panes at night and a tap mid-ease hits the wrong face — apply the composite's k (viewS / gview.s and the origin shift) to the live overlays and the hit-test for the duration of the ease, exactly as drawScene composites gcv. c120: on a desktop the Far bank quarter is clamped by the world's east edge into nearly the plaza frame — give it a tighter box (QUARTERS[4]) or let viewFor raise s for it so the far bank fills the frame at 1400 px.
successLooksLike: A night filmstrip through a Wide → Far bank ease shows the pane glows on their panes on every frame (crop the church tower mid-ease, before and after). At 1400 px the Far bank quarter's s is visibly higher than the Plaza's and the mill fills a third of the frame. Wide-view hash IDENTICAL to HEAD; frame-cost unchanged.
avoid: Do not move FOCUS. Do not repaint the ground cache per frame during the ease.
